[SOLAR & ATMOSPHERIC LIGHTING OVERRIDE]
SOLAR RELIGHTING DIRECTIVE (4500K Late afternoon raking sunlight with warm golden highlights):

Mature groves of Quercus phellos, Ulmus americana, and Platanus occidentalis with dense, deep-green late-summer canopies displaying faint early-autumn tip chlorosis. All vertical architectural lines plumb and planar facades rectified. Static urban landscape entirely free of vehicles, pedestrians, and temporary clutter.
